verification_status: Source-inspected and independently statically reviewed; file/span hashes checked. Exact frozen revision not natively reproduced. Pending formal task-set freeze; no solver run authorized by this package.
reference_answer: Indexed conditions become an inverted result. get_bf_by_keys_and_update sees count zero, extracts no IDs, resets the indexed filter/result, and returns an engaged optional. FtsRecallNode moves that value into ordinary vector candidate_ids. Its empty value is also the unrestricted default. FTS only intersects nonempty candidates, and the remaining filter no longer contains this indexed predicate, allowing ordinary FTS hits. Scalar-only query instead iterates the empty scalar result; a field without inverted index is evaluated by a remaining forward filter. A nonempty restriction still admits only qualifying documents, so a disjoint text hit set is empty. Preserve no-restriction vs explicit-empty vs nonempty restriction at the handoff and consumer, or short-circuit a computed zero result safely. Test zero-result FTS plus ordinary unrestricted, overlap, disjoint and forward/scalar controls.

criteria.full_credit: Explains that a computed inverted result with count zero qualifies for the candidate-ID path, returns a present-but-empty optional, and clears the indexed filter/result when handing off those IDs. Zero matches is a real restrictive outcome, not absence of a scalar condition.
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point: Correctly identifies zero-result handling and candidate handoff but omits either optional presence or consumption/reset of the indexed constraint.

criteria.claim: FTS consumer loses the restrictive empty state
criteria.full_credit: Connects ordinary vector candidate representation and the nonempty-only intersection guard: absent and explicit empty candidates collapse; no candidate intersection runs, and the remaining filter no longer carries the indexed predicate, so matching text hits can be emitted.
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point: Identifies either empty-candidate bypass or loss of the indexed predicate, but does not connect the two to FTS traversal.

criteria.full_credit: 1 point for scalar-only using an empty inverted iterator as its source; 1 point for the unindexed forward filter retaining/evaluating the predicate and for nonempty indexed/forward constraints retaining correct positive or disjoint results. Does not assume every positive-match predicate uses candidate IDs, since optimizer/threshold may choose another path.
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point: Correctly explains one of the two control groups above.

criteria.full_credit: Proposes a source-grounded repair preserving unrestricted, explicitly empty and nonempty-restricted search end to end, e.g. optional candidate state with reject-all on present-empty or a safe zero-result short-circuit before constraint loss. Preserves remaining delete/forward constraints and ordinary unfiltered queries.
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point: Suggests special handling of zero results without explaining preservation of the ordinary unrestricted path or the consumed-filter handoff. A pointer-only bitmap change without addressing subsequent reset is insufficient for full credit.

criteria.full_credit: 1 point for an end-to-end zero-match indexed-scalar + matching-FTS regression with expected empty IDs and a scalar-only or unindexed control; 1 point for a boundary matrix covering no scalar restriction, nonempty overlap and nonempty disjoint cases, while keeping valid results/topk/remaining filter behavior. No need to copy the upstream test name or write executable code.
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point: Covers one of the two test groups above with explicit expected behavior.

critical_contradictions: Claims that a null bitmap is necessary for this defect and that a non-null zero-cardinality bitmap avoids the consumed-filter/candidate handoff failure.
Claims the indexed scalar condition remains effective after its filter/result are reset while the FTS candidate restriction is skipped.
Claims that changing only make_filter() to return a non-null reject-all filter repairs the scenario despite the later consumption/reset.
Proposes treating every empty candidate vector as reject-all in the pre-fix API without preserving the ordinary unrestricted search path.
Attributes the FTS result leak to an established vector-only defect based solely on a similar remaining-filter assignment, without evidence for the different vector candidate consumer.
Claims all positive/disjoint controls must use candidate-ID extraction, contradicting the retained-bitmap/forward alternatives in the frozen source.

scoring_rules: Score supported factual claims and causal reasoning, never wording, verbosity, tool choice or exact upstream patch syntax.
Allow equivalent valid code citations/ranges and alternative correct explanations; these evidence IDs are reference support, not mandatory literal wording.
A proposed regression design is sufficient. Do not require installation, execution or code changes. Unsupported claims of executed tests are not evidence.
Each criterion is worth 0, 1 or 2 points. Grade against the frozen pre-fix source, not the reporter rootcause narrative.
reviewed_corrections: A null bitmap is not required: a non-null bitmap of cardinality zero also yields an empty candidate vector and loses the indexed filter after reset.
DocFilter::empty() need not be true universally. Remaining delete or forward filters can exist, while the indexed scalar restriction has still been lost.
Changing make_filter() to produce a non-null reject-all filter alone is not sufficient if get_bf_by_keys_and_update() later consumes/resets it.
Do not generalize to vector-only queries from the similar remaining-filter assignment. Its explicit empty inner candidate list follows a different downstream path.
Nonempty filter controls can use candidates, a retained bitmap, or forward evaluation depending on selectivity; all preserve a meaningful restriction.
